long_biography.plain_text:
Botero built an eclectic career before entering her father’s studio full-time. She worked as a television presenter and arts journalist, founded decoration magazines, designed jewellery and developed an interior-design practice. In 2012, Mexico’s Palacio de Bellas Artes appointed her to curate a major retrospective, beginning a sustained collaboration that made her one of Fernando Botero’s closest professional partners.

After his death in 2023, she joined her brothers in organising the works and properties he left behind and carrying out his testamentary request for a foundation. Her remit centres on exhibitions, publications, archive cataloguing and the catalogue raisonné. That role combines inherited stewardship with active cultural production: she curates international shows and manages the infrastructure intended to preserve access to Botero’s work.

uncertainties: Identity is resolved at 96. The uncommon full name, 1958 birth year, Colombian nationality, Monaco context, official acting record and linaboteroz Instagram converge with an exact Forbes interview and current cultural profiles of Bogotá-born curator Lina Botero Zea. Numerous younger professionals and creators named Lina Botero were excluded because they lack the Beatriz Botero Zea, 1958, Fernando Botero, Monaco and 2012-curatorial pattern.

Public yacht sources verify a 40.7-metre Sanlorenzo Gitana closely matching the authoritative specification but withhold the owner's name. The current person-to-vessel relationship therefore depends on the authoritative owner record rather than an independent public disclosure. This limitation lowers identity confidence from 100 but does not create a plausible competing Lina Beatriz Botero Zea identity.

The authoritative relationship begins in August 2024, while public sources describe Gitana as launched in 2026. The earlier date is plausibly a project or construction relationship, but no reviewed source explains it, so the biographies contain no acquisition or delivery narrative.

The authoritative input reports 420 GT, while SuperYacht Times reports 419 GT. The one-tonne discrepancy may reflect rounding or project-stage measurement, but it is unresolved and is excluded from editorial biography.

The existing LinkedIn URL belongs to Alessandro Noli, whom Forbes identifies as Botero's partner, not to Lina Botero. It is flagged for guarded removal through candidates_requiring_review. Searches returned many namesakes but no collision-safe personal LinkedIn replacement.
The existing linaboteroz Instagram is independently attributed to Fernando Botero's daughter Lina in public coverage. It is preserved as an existing profile and not duplicated in proposals.

Media & Entertainment is the closest approved broad industry for a family wealth platform created through fine art and now stewarded through exhibitions, publishing, archives and a foundation. It does not imply that Lina created Fernando Botero's artistic fortune or that the foundation itself is necessarily a for-profit business.

Inherited is based on the children's post-death organisation of works, properties and affairs under Fernando Botero's will and foundation mandate. Public sources do not disclose Lina's exact legal share, the division of individual works, estate values, trust structures or whether every relevant asset is personally owned. No net-worth estimate is adopted.

Operator reflects Botero's sustained curatorial work since 2012 and her intensive current work on exhibitions, the foundation, archive and catalogue raisonné. Reviewed sources do not establish a formal chief-executive title, sole control or day-to-day responsibility for every estate asset, so her siblings' distinct roles are not transferred to her.

No approved active tag cleanly represents a fine-art curator and artistic-estate steward. Art collector requires a personally notable collection, Art dealer requires a commercial dealing role, Talent agent / manager is not her evidenced formal occupation, and Film producer would overstate one documentary. Proposed tags therefore remains empty rather than stretching the closed taxonomy.

The known-for proposal describes Botero as curator and foundation co-founder. It does not call her the foundation's sole director, owner or chief executive, because no reviewed source supports those titles.

The 1958 birth year already present upstream is supported by Forbes and La Vanguardia and therefore needs no proposal. Bogotá and Colombia are proposed for the blank birthplace fields. No reliable source establishes a birth day, birth month, second nationality, suffix or personal website.

The main-residence field remains Monaco because it is nonblank upstream. Current interviews describe moves between Monaco, Mexico, Colombia, Italy and wider Europe but do not establish a durable replacement or a sufficiently precise secondary-residence field.

The replacement biography removes the transient age and partner/residence framing in the existing text. Both biographies are source-invisible and sale-independent, omit Gitana and estate valuations, and distinguish Lina's independent career from the inherited family platform and her active stewardship.
